_readme: Pinned Obsidian plugin/theme releases. The exact bytes these pins verify against ship inside the plugin at plugin/vendor/obsidian/<id>/ (theme: plugin/vendor/obsidian/Minimal/), so provision_plugins.py installs offline; the GitHub download is only a fallback for an asset missing from the vendored tree. To bump a pin: edit the tag, run scripts/refresh_vendor.py --record (downloads the assets, records their sha256 here, rewrites plugin/vendor/), read the diff, update plugin/vendor/obsidian/LICENSES.md if the licence or tag changed, commit. Never edit plugin/vendor/ by hand. license_file is the licence text's path in the upstream repo at the pinned tag; refresh_vendor.py vendors it as LICENSE next to the assets. dataview is deliberately pinned to 0.5.68 — 0.5.70 is a mislabeled beta with a broken manifest asset. obsidian-style-settings' canonical repo is community-archive/... (renamed from obsidian-community/..., which still redirects).
